verdict.rationale: SerpApi doesn't explicitly address AI-training use of customer data, but its ZeroTrace Mode claims that once a search completes, no search parameters/files/data are stored, which would preclude such data being used to train models — an indirect but relevant privacy control. missing for 10: explicit AI-training data-use policy/statement, opt-out mechanism specifically for AI training, and independent verification of ZeroTrace Mode's scope.
